# Frontend Client-Side Security Review -- secman

## Executive Summary

The secman frontend has a generally sound security posture. The migration from JWT-in-localStorage to HttpOnly cookies is a significant improvement. However, I identified several findings ranging from a committed credential to excessive logging and inconsistent authentication patterns. Below are the findings organized by severity.
